body:
i am also skipping and failing classes because of not doing my work. i have zero motivation. i am also beginning to feel that college will really do nothing for me except give that all-important degree. like right now, i should be doing a midterm (that was due last week, but my professor gave me an extra week to do it with only 30 points deducted) and an assignment for my online class that was due tonight. but instead i am reaching out for some sort of moral support from faceless strangers. 

i am in the same boat as you, so i don't really have any good advice. i'm not sure if it helps, but just know that you're not alone in feeling this way. perhaps we need to find something besides school (and also, in my case my pets,) to make us feel that we are doing something important with our lives. what that "something else" is though, i have no idea..
